description:
## Functional specifications and ownership
System owns configuration; add a focused WebBrowsingConfig module under lib/zaq/system/ and grouped read/save APIs in lib/zaq/system.ex, exposed through supported Engine events/API. Use system.web_browsing.allowed_domains and system.web_browsing.screenshots.{provider,config_id,scope_id,folder_id,folder_path} keys in existing system_configs; no new persistence mechanism. Save atomically with validated input. Domain entries are exact hostnames: trim, lowercase, deduplicate; reject malformed names, schemes, paths, ports and wildcard patterns in this initial UI. Blank/whitespace means unrestricted. Distinguish missing/default configuration from unavailable/corrupt reads; failures must not silently allow all domains. Screenshot destination can be unset while browsing remains usable; a supplied destination must be coherent and use an enabled create-capable datasource.

## Contract and rollout
Read returns typed policy/destination; save returns the canonical group or validation errors. Global policy replaces model arguments and AGENT_BROWSER_ALLOWED_DOMAINS. Document migration for existing deployments so operators preserve restrictions deliberately; do not silently claim old environment restrictions remain active. Domain edits require restarting all Agent containers/browser processes for guaranteed application; an Elixir-only restart is insufficient. Destination changes affect future captures only, not existing files. No hot daemon-policy reconciliation or session redesign. Use established trusted admin authorization and Engine event boundaries; nil identity is never elevation.

## Tests to add before implementation / branches
System and Engine tests: missing keys, blank/whitespace, normalization idempotence/property, duplicate hosts, invalid input, partial destination, disabled/mismatched provider config, atomic rollback, unauthorized save, unavailable/corrupt config, scope/folder round trip. Preserve existing config tests.

## Action reuse assessment
Extend System grouped-config pattern and Engine events; inspect get/save_skill_resource_config and typed PeopleAccessConfig instead of duplicating a store. These are configuration service operations, not new agent-exposed Actions. Consumers: BO writes and Agent runtime reads through NodeRouter events. No new generic invoke operation.

## Mocking and docs
Keep System/Ecto/events real; inject only external provider edges and established runtime configuration dependencies. Update docs/services/system-config.md (keys, blank semantics, destination, restart and env migration) and module/API docs. Read system-config, engine and BO auth owners before edits.

## Execution constraints and policies
Planning only; do not mark complete without implementation evidence. Future implementation uses a new branch in the current worktree, not another worktree; do not commit/push without authorization. Read AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/action-reuse.md and docs/testing-approach.md. Read each affected module @moduledoc and relevant service owner before editing. Follow the authoritative validation lifecycle rather than inventing alternate gates. Preserve existing assertions. New feature E2E authoring is deferred until the separate human approval issue closes.
